description: Validates that a boundary-scoped use-case model exists with actor, boundary, and requirement traceability and a linked detailed script per use case. Run with --boundary pointing at the boundary folder.

checks.description: The use-case model (JSON and Markdown) and the script index must exist for the target boundary
checks.remediation: Run usecase-generatemodel against the target boundary's domain/process/collaboration documents

checks.description: The model's boundary_ref must carry an explicit boundary_type of software or non-software
checks.remediation: Do not generate a model against a boundary whose boundary_type is unknown or undeclared (contract Section 2.1); stop and surface the clarification question instead

checks.description: Every use case must carry an ID, name, goal, primary actor, boundary reference, and script reference
checks.remediation: Ensure every use case references exactly one primary actor and the same boundary_id as its owning model

checks.description: Every use case must carry at least one requirement reference
checks.remediation: A use case with no supporting requirement should be reconsidered, not silently generated

checks.description: Every use case's script_ref must follow use-case-scripts/UC-[###]-[slug].md
checks.remediation: Generate a linked script at use-case-scripts/UC-[###]-[slug].md for every modeled use case (model-validatealignment verifies each file actually exists)

checks.description: Every script must have Trigger, Preconditions, Main Flow, and Postconditions sections
checks.remediation: Complete each script per contract Section 3.2; Alternative/Exception Paths and UI References are the only sections that may be omitted

checks.description: Scripts for a non-software boundary must not contain a UI References section
checks.remediation: UI References sections are only permitted when boundary_type is software and a concrete Screen/UIModelEntry mapping exists for that step (contract Section 2.2)

checks.description: Use case IDs should follow the UC-[###] convention, scoped per boundary
checks.remediation: Use the UC-[###] zero-padded 3-digit format, scoped per boundary per contract Section 3.3

checks.description: The model should carry a changelog documenting revision history, including any flagged unresolved references
checks.remediation: Document revision history; flag unresolved requirement/process references explicitly instead of dropping or renumbering use cases
